https://glossdaily.example/lumiere-labs-.headline: Lumiere Labs brings its first vitamin C serum to Sephora
https://glossdaily.example/lumiere-labs-.dek: Four outlets report the launch, which is priced at $38 and arrives with limited stock.
body: Lumiere Labs has put its first vitamin C serum on sale at Sephora. Gloss Daily gives the price as $38 and reports that it is arriving in stores this week.
The Powder Room says stock is limited at launch. Trade Beauty Weekly adds that distribution is due to widen next quarter.
Gulf Glam reports that the serum is now at Sephora stores in the Middle East, with pricing in dirhams listed in store.
